name: Wanderer's Soul

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text: Your soul is especially able to return to the cycle of reincarnation. When you're the subject of Raise Dead, Reincarnate, or a similar ritual that would return you to life, the primary caster uses the outcome one degree of success better than their roll. You always return to life as a samsaran, even if the ritual would reincarnate you into a body of a different ancestry.
